recipe.name: By The Hair of My... - David Lebovitz
directions: Rinse and sterilize jars with boiling water.
Dissolve 3/4 cups (150g) of sugar in 3-4 tablespoons hot water in a 1-quart (1 liter) preserving jar with a well-fitting lid.
Pour two scant cups of decent, but not outrageously expensive brandy or Cognac the plums.
Secure the lid and tilt the jar to mix everything together.
Store the jar in a cool place for a few weeks, then refrigerate.

ingredients.name: Plums
ingredients.notes: small, roughly the size of a French bureaucrats petit boule

ingredients.name: Scant Cups Cups Brandy
ingredients.notes: alt: Cognac, decent, but not outrageously expensive
